nodes.statement: Fix n>=2 source carrier sites, a target alphabet {0,1}, two specified consumer readout roles, plant ports, and an event-parent/time signature; installed routing and actual executed intake events are distinct coordinates.
nodes.scope: One finite installation and its explicitly bound episode family. A numerical readout is a prediction only with separately grounded preconsequence timing.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: Both numerical consumers copy one fixed source each: y=x_a, yhat=x_b for a,b in {0,...,n-1}. Calibrated identity plant and pure route law are declared; routes are stable across the specified reset probe family.
nodes.scope: All ordered route pairs within the pure fixed-route class; no undeclared aggregation, bypass, writer or route switching.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: At every step of the arbitrary finite target word all source values equal target t; action and prediction use the calibrated pure-route law. If the R204 forward state is appended, initialize identity F and use precisely its error-gated or unconditional row replacement with veridical matched feedback.
nodes.scope: Nominal episode words only. Diagnostic probes may deliberately destroy success or alignment; actual write events may differ although state traces agree.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: Declare the admissible binary source-input family, exact intervention sites and times, fixed response law, faithful stated consumer/mismatch readouts, and route/reset stability. Each probe is jointly bound to these same physical or modeled ports, consumers and episode ordering.
nodes.scope: A schedule W may be restricted; full source-control permission is a separate premise. Installed sources are not post-injection actual ancestry. Probe results alone do not certify a past episode.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: Every x in {0,1}^n can be independently imposed on the declared source sites within the same valid probe contract.
nodes.scope: Source interventions only; this does not grant node writes, branch replacements, chronology readouts, or access to all possible hidden contexts.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: The protocol is deterministic, exact and uniform over all unknown fixed ordered pure-route pairs; it receives mismatch bits only and is scored by its worst-case number of source probes.
nodes.scope: Zero-error equality decision a=b, including adaptive schedules. Does not identify the ordered roots, local source, history or intake occurrence.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: The motor consumer has a single independently known root a. The predictor copies one unknown root or OR-aggregates one unknown nonempty source subset B. The declared model class is fixed independently of the classification outcome.
nodes.scope: n>=2; alternatives are explicit model classes. For the OR alternative the target is B={a}; empty constant-zero predictors are excluded.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: Both consumers independently OR-aggregate arbitrary nonempty source subsets A and B of the n source sites: y=OR_{i in A} x_i and yhat=OR_{i in B} x_i. Routes and subset memberships are fixed across probes.
nodes.scope: This response class replaces the pure-route promise. Individual input reads need not make an unmasked difference in the present input context.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: The protocol is deterministic and exact uniformly over every ordered pair of nonempty source subsets A,B, with mismatch-only readouts and worst-case probe cost; adaptive schedules are allowed.
nodes.scope: Decide equality A=B, not overlap, same current effect, or common carrier intake. n>=2 is essential to the displayed lower-bound witnesses.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: Compare finite acyclic faithful-copy networks sharing the same composite source-to-consumer map. The specified negative-control pair uses either one common relay intake carrier or two separate equal copied relay carriers.
nodes.scope: Source input/readout equivalence is universal over the declared binary source cube; relay factorization and actual intake occurrence may differ.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: For the displayed relay pair, set every source input to 0 and independently identify the predictor intake carrier, initially carrying 0. The node probe writes 1 before both relevant consumer reads with no intervening overwrite or compensation; the edge probe independently replaces only the predictor intake branch by 1. The nontrivial value change is part of the probe contract.
nodes.scope: Exact specified node/edge probes and fixed paths. Source-level intervention permissions alone do not supply this stronger capability.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: Compare a preconsequence pure-root predictive readout and a postconsequence sensory copy of the resulting action, with the same root source law and all numerical readouts retained. The actual read/consequence order differs and must be independently observed to assign a prediction role.
nodes.scope: The full numerical source/readout cube is available; chronological evidence is a separate coordinate, not inferred from value match.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: Independently admit the actual bearer/process, interval and complete P/I/K signature; ground the actual source/intake/consumer/time and relevant context relations in that same instance. Do not discharge these premises with model enumeration or report labels.
nodes.scope: An actual episode or independently admitted overlapping actual processes; all coordinates must coexist in the same relevant complete organization.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: Use C1 only with the complete actual signature and grounded role formulas, transporting all relevant physical parameters and bindings. Selecting a subrelation as a formula is distinct from claiming a separately actual experiential substructure.
nodes.scope: Preserves complete actual organizational twins under transported naming; does not choose a subject owner or a named phenomenological endpoint.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: No result here grounds familiar-me H, conceptual self, report validity, local membership, RetBind, or numerical personal identity. Any such endpoint needs its own appropriate actual and semantic premises.
nodes.scope: No basal-experience existence threshold is introduced. Absence of alignment, performance, use, or source confluence does not negate basal experience.
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.

nodes.statement: For every n>=2, route pair (a,b) and finite target word, setting all source values to each target yields correct action and prediction with zero discrepancy at every step; an appended calibrated R204 row-replacement predictor retains the same forward-state trace.
nodes.scope: n>=2; arbitrary finite nominal target words; pure fixed routes with a calibrated identity plant/predictor
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.
limits: Nominal equality is not equality under arbitrary diagnostic probes.
Actual writes can differ while register states match.

nodes.statement: For schedule W with source columns c_i, full consumer readouts yield product fibers of equal columns; mismatch-only observation yields {(i,j):c_i XOR c_j=d}. Under a restricted intervention family sources equivalent on every admissible input remain indistinguishable.
nodes.scope: fixed nonadaptive schedule; finite source sites and pure route consumers
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.
limits: Mismatch-only data generally do not identify an ordered route pair.
A source-code collision is not absence of actual use.

nodes.statement: For n>=2 unknown pure-route roots, uniform exact decision of their equality using binary source interventions and mismatch-only observations has worst-case minimum ceil(log2 n), including deterministic adaptive protocols.
nodes.scope: n>=2; all unknown ordered route pairs; deterministic exact worst-case protocols
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.
limits: Does not identify which shared root or local production.

nodes.statement: For n>=2 and an independently known motor root a, setting a to zero and all other roots to one decides equality with an unknown predictor root in one probe. It also identifies B={a} for a predictor OR of a nonempty subset B.
nodes.scope: n>=2; independently known single motor source; pure or nonempty-OR predictor
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.
limits: A report of authorship is not independently known source identity.
Empty constant-zero predictor is outside the OR extension.

nodes.statement: For n>=2, exact uniform equality decision between arbitrary nonempty OR source subsets requires exactly n probes in the worst case, even adaptively. Along the zero-discrepancy branch each unit input e_i is necessary; all unit inputs suffice. A four-source disjoint-set construction defeats the two-bit pure-route code.
nodes.scope: n>=2; both consumers OR arbitrary nonempty subsets of the n sources; all pairs of subsets; exact worst-case mismatch-only protocol
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.
limits: Target is equality of root sets, not nonempty intersection or intake identity.
No claim that biological prediction implements OR.

nodes.statement: Faithful copy networks with the same composite root-to-consumer map yield identical readouts for all source inputs, while immediate intake carrier identity can differ. A node write and a branch-edge replacement can have distinct cross-consumer effects; only the former separates the displayed shared/separate relay pair under additional targeting premises.
nodes.scope: finite faithful-copy feedforward networks; common composite source map; specific shared/separate relay alternative for clamp comparison
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.
limits: Does not recover actual prior-episode occurrence, RetBind or numerical personal identity.
Edge effect does not establish shared carrier occurrence.

nodes.statement: A postconsequence copy can match all source/readout values of a preconsequence predictor; values alone do not establish the prediction role. The event model distinguishes the implementations by independently recorded chronology.
nodes.scope: one pure-root source/actuation response; pre- versus post-consequence readout alternatives; complete source input cube
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.
limits: Numerical agreement is not executed prediction or executed comparator evidence.
Timing measurement and interpretation require actual validation.

nodes.statement: Only under actual-process admission, one complete P/I/K binding, grounded role/trace/time relations, transported physical parameters and C1 do the actual source-consumer relations have experiential structural counterparts. No source confluence, calibration, use, history, language or report threshold is added; H, local membership and conceptual self are not inferred.
nodes.scope: one admitted actual process or independently admitted overlapping processes; common complete signature; all relevant parameters transported
nodes.quantifier: For every single declared model instance satisfying all stated joint premises; actual application remains independently open.
limits: No unique owner or current-assistant consciousness claim.
Complete-organizational twins are not a free phenomenal-difference counterexample inside C1.

context_links.statement: C1 is inherited; the model does not empirically prove it or substitute a selected output relation for a complete actual signature.
No source, alignment, performance, use, agency, language or report condition is added as a basal-experience gate.
No named H endpoint, conceptual-self inference or report validity is supplied.
Correct complete-instance parameter transport is inherited and remains distinct from naming a feeling.
Grounded relation formulas do not automatically select separately actual experiential substructures.
Common source ancestry or an observed probe effect does not establish same-lineage actual retention.
Matched prediction with different physical action/source allocation is prior-covered; the new application concerns scoped protocol synthesis and resolution.
The earlier relative-routing observation limit is retained; exact source-column fibers are a specified source-probe application.
Source versus mediator/branch probes require different actual intervention capabilities; general path logic is inherited.
Equal source root and equal copy values do not establish shared intake-carrier occurrence.
A claimed physical node target needs independent fidelity and timing grounds; an API label alone does not discharge them.
A branch-edge intervention can mimic one-sided influence without establishing the candidate carrier identity.
Probe-family stability does not by itself recover a previous episode’s actual lineage.
Redundant-source comparison has inherited duplicate/cancellation background, but OR, XOR and modular subtraction are distinct response classes and their identification bounds cannot be merged.
Potential contribution under some backup context is distinct from current unmasked effect, actual intake occurrence, and diagnostic evidence.
Prediction versus sensory copying depends on actual chronology; numerical readout labels do not supply that chronology.
